text:
Alex: Quick Q: for /v2/generate, how are we classifying errors? validation vs model failures vs infra transient. Want guidance so SDKs can map retry behavior.
Maya: Short answer: client-side input validation -> 4xx. For malformed JSON use 400, for semantic validation (prompt too long, forbidden content) use 422. :thinking_face:
Jordan: +1. For backend/model issues use 5xx. Prefer 503 for temporary capacity/overload (retryable), 500 for internal crashes (not safe to retry). 429 for rate limits.
Alex: What about partial failures (e.g., generation cut off due to context length)? Return 200 + warnings or a 4xx/5xx?
Maya: Prefer 200 + a warnings array in the response body when the request succeeded but with caveats. We don't want to break callers expecting text.
Jordan: Proposed error envelope (keep compact):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "model_overloaded",    
    "message": "Model at capacity, try shortly",
    "type": "temporary",        
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 10,           
    "details": {"pool":"g4dn-xlarge"}
  },
  "warnings": ["response_truncated_due_to_context_limit"]
}
```
Jordan: Note: use explicit boolean "retryable" so SDKs can decide. Keep 422 strictly for semantic validation issues.
Sam: SDK note: older clients treat non-200 as terminal. Can we add an "x-redwood-error-version: 2" header or an "error_schema_version" field so SDKs can progressively enhance behavior? @Maya @Jordan
Alex: Good call — backward-compatibility concern. For any change that might flip a 200->4xx for a case we currently return 200 for, prefer adding warnings instead. Also include an "error_schema_version" in body so uptakes are explicit.
Jordan: Agreed. Also suggest including "error_class" like (validation|quota|transient|internal) to standardize handling across endpoints. And include "retry_after" for 429/503 when possible.
Maya: I'll update the API spec and add examples in the PR. I'll also add a short table mapping code -> retryable (e.g., 429,503 -> true; 422,400 -> false). Will ping @Sam for SDK changes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging for branch api-errors at 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC.
Alex: Thanks everyone — if no objections I'll merge the API spec PR tomorrow EOD.
Sam: lgtm from SDK side, will add handling for error_schema_version and retryable flag.
Maya: closing loop: PR link shortly (will include migration notes).
